resource_gate.scope: full post-route design including PS-PL clock/reset, AXI DMA, interconnect and operator IP
resource_gate.rationale: Thirty percent is reserved for DMA and control shell growth, routing congestion, clock/reset infrastructure and later full-network integration. FF remains recorded/advisory rather than an operator rejection metric.

timing_gate.rationale: A positive 0.2 ns margin is required instead of accepting a zero-margin route at 200 MHz.

board_performance_gate.energy_definition: integrated active energy minus matched idle baseline energy divided by completed operations
board_performance_gate.rationale: The latency and incremental-power ceilings are fixed before outcomes; the energy ceiling is their conservative product and is verified against integrated energy, not substituted for it.

thermal_gate.rationale: The normal gate leaves at least 12 C after accounting for the DS925 example of plus/minus 3 C SysMon error; 90 C is a safety stop, not a passing threshold.

claim_boundary: These are engineering admission budgets, not AMD guaranteed deployment limits and not candidate measurements. They do not promote any HLS, route, bitstream, latency, power or energy gate.
